cohort: 78 women with postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) at the Department of Obstetrics, Charité, university hospital Berlin, between October 2016 and June 2018
finding: Chitosan covered gauze is an excellent option for treating PPH, appearing at least equivalent to balloon tamponade.
mod_finding: Chitosan covered gauze was found to be a particularly suitable treatment for postpartum hemorrhage after spontaneous delivery or cesarean sections.
